verdict.rationale: Figma's first-party pages describe working together in multiplayer files with cursor chat in one shared space, and creating and prototyping together in real time in one place. This clearly covers simultaneous team editing. Live cursors are only implied by 'cursor chat', and instant sync is asserted as 'real-time' but never described in depth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live presence cursors and sync behavior/latency, independent or hands-on corroboration of multiplayer editing.
